headline: Spot Bitcoin Funds Shed $487 Million as Bitcoin Holds Near 83k and Greed Runs Ahead of the Cash
narrative: Spot bitcoin funds lost $487 million in the latest print, ether funds lost $161 million, and solana funds lost $4.8 million, while bitcoin holds near 83k after a 1.3% decline. Fear and greed reads 69, greed, while the cycle index sits flat at 56 in complacency, so sentiment has moved further than the money. Funding is calm at 0.004%, the dollar is firm at 102.57, and volatility is quiet, with the VIX at 15.2 and seven-day realized volatility at 21.3% against 48.9% over thirty days, so the cash leaving the funds is not being chased by leverage or a volatility bid.
author: jordan
